{"path":"out/triage-automation-week1.md","content":"# One-Week Triage Automation Trial

## Goal
Reduce manual triage time from ~30 min/day to <5 min/day by end of week.

## Day 1 (Mon) — Baseline & Rules
- Export last 30 days of tickets (subject, body, category, priority) → CSV
- Define 5–7 routing rules (keywords → category + priority):
  - "cracked|broken|damaged|defective" → product, P1
  - "refund|return" → billing, P2
  - "late|not arrived|tracking" → shipping, P1
  - "charged twice|double charge" → billing, P1
  - "hot|burn|safety" → product, P1
  - "change|update|address" → shipping, P2
  - "ship to|deliver to|Ireland|EU" → shipping, P3
- Write a 50-line Python script: read ticket → apply rules → output suggested category/priority

## Day 2 (Tue) — Shadow Mode
- Run script on today's new tickets (cron every 30 min)
- Log suggestions to `out/triage-log.csv` (ticket_id, suggested_cat, suggested_pri, rule_matched)
- Manual triage continues; compare at EOD

## Day 3 (Wed) — Tune Rules
- Review false positives/negatives from log
- Add 2–3 negative keywords (e.g., "not damaged" → skip product/P1)
- Add "espresso|roast|coffee" → product, P3 (informational)
- Re-run on last 7 days to validate

## Day 4 (Thu) — Semi-Auto
- For tickets where confidence ≥ 2 matching rules: auto-set category+priority via `shop__update_ticket`
- Keep P1 safety: never auto-assign P1 without human confirm
- Log every auto-action

## Day 5 (Fri) — Measure & Decide
- Metrics:
  - Tickets auto-triaged / total
  - Time saved (manual vs auto)
  - Overrides needed
  - Customer-visible errors (should be 0)
- Go/no-go: if ≥ 60% auto-triaged with 0 errors → keep; else iterate

## Success Criteria
- ≥ 60% of new tickets get correct category+priority without human touch
- Zero misrouted P1 tickets
- Team feels confident to run it next week

## Rollback
- Disable cron, delete auto-assign logic, revert to manual — 5 min."}
